info.title: Orders
info.description: Provides methods to create, retrieve, change, and cancel orders for physical and subscription products across multiple channels. Orders are primarily created based on the payload received from an external application or an online store (additional configuration required). Orders can be retrieved by the service based on various search criteria, such as order ID, customer, order status, owner, or market.

x-sap-shortText: Enables you to retrieve, create, change, and cancel orders.

patch.summary: Cancels or changes an order at specific points in the order lifecycle.
patch.description:
Cancels or makes certain changes to an order at specific points in the order lifecycle. The use cases for this endpoint are described below:

**A. Changes an order in status `TRANSFER_ON_HOLD`**

The types of changes permitted are limited to those represented in the `orderUpdateRequest` model. Note that if you make changes to the information in the following elements of payload, you must send all the information within the element, even the unchanged values:

- `payment`
- `fees`
- `orderItems`
- `shipments`

**B. Cancels an order during processing**

This endpoint allows someone other than the end customer, for example, a retailer or system administrator, to cancel an order during processing. Orders in all statuses except `IN_TRANSFER`, `CANCELED`, and `CANCELED_DURING_PROCESSING` can be canceled during the fulfillment phase of order processing. After cancellation, the order status becomes `CANCELED_DURING_PROCESSING`.

**C. Changes an order item during processing**

Changes an order item during processing when an order is in one of the following statuses:

- `TRANSFER_STARTED`
- `TRANSFER_SUCCESSFUL`
- `TRANSFER_FAILED`
- `TRANSFER_PARTIALLY_FAILED`

This allows you to cancel an item in an order, reduce or increase an item's quantity, add an item, and change the information in the custom fields. Note that the custom field information can also be changed when an order is in status `CANCELED` or `CANCELED_DURING_PROCESSING`.

**D. Changes an order header during processing**

Changes an order header during processing when an order is in one of the following statuses:

- `TRANSFER_SUCCESSFUL`
- `CANCELED`
- `CANCELED_DURING_PROCESSING`

This allows you to change certain information in certain fields. For a list of fields that cannot be changed, see the Order Change information in the Service Guide.

**E. Retriggers an order**

Retriggers an order in status `READY_FOR_TRANSFER`, `IN_TRANSFER`, `IN_TRANSFER_FAILED`, or `PENDING`.

**F. Cancels an order**

Cancels an order in status `PENDING` or `TRANSFER_ON_HOLD`. Orders in status `TRANSFER_ON_HOLD` can only be canceled before the time recorded in the `transferHoldEndAt` field.

Note that the full request cannot exceed 2 MB.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The latest version of the order that you want to change or cancel. This value can be retrieved from the "ETag" header of the /orders/{id} endpoint (GET operation).

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: The technical identifier of an order, for example, 'e10fdb83-5a51-419a-btr6-5d34bb2be0da'.

oms-correlation-id.description: The unique identifier generated for changes to an order contained in a specific asynchronous PATCH request. This ID is included in the 202 response message that the system generates for the order change and in the related Order Changed event, which allows you to match the event with the specific request that triggered it even when change requests are received concurrently from multiple systems.

get.description:
Retrieves orders based on a combination of filters. Uses server-side pagination with a default of 10 orders per page. If there are more than 10 orders to retrieve, the results will include a relative link to the next page (`links[0].href`). The returned orders are sorted by newly modified or created orders first by default. Note that blocked orders are only returned if you have the auditor role.
Each tenant has a limit of 500 requests per second.

parameters.name: Prefer
parameters.description: Controls the number of orders per page. For example, `maxpagesize=20` retrieves 20 orders per page. Maximum 100. When omitted, the default is 10.

parameters.name: $select
parameters.description:
The header-level order fields to include in the results. The orders retrieved will contain the information
for the fields and subfields you select here.
By default, all fields are selected. You can also use an asterisk ("*") to select all fields.
To include only certain fields, use a comma-separated list of fields.

To exclude a field, add a minus ("-") sign before the field name. Example: `-orderItems, -prices`.
Included fields take precedence over excluded fields. Note that the `id` field cannot be excluded.

You can include the following fields in your search:
- `id`: This field is always part of the result.
- `businessObjectId`
- `version`
- `precedingDocument`
- `owner`
- `metadata`
- `displayId`
- `channel`
- `status`
- `market`
- `payment`
- `description`
- `pricingDate`
- `prices`
- `fees`
- `discount`
- `fulfillment`
- `customer`
- `shipToParty`
- `orderItems`
- `sourcing`
- `transferHoldEndAt`
- `customFields`

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description:
The fields to use as search filters. A maximum of 10 parameters is allowed.
You define your search criteria for the orders you want to return using the following fields:
- `orderId`
- `orderDisplayId`: Enter a number without quotation marks.
- `createdAt`
- `modifiedAt`
- `status`
- `marketId`
- `owner`
- `transferHoldEndAt`
- `precedingDocumentExternalSystemId`: Searches on `precedingDocument.externalSystemReference.externalSystemId`
- `precedingDocumentExternalId`: Searches on `precedingDocument.externalSystemReference.externalId`
- `precedingDocumentExternalNumber`: Searches on `precedingDocument.externalSystemReference.externalNumber`
- `customerId`: Searches on `customer.cuid`
- `customerDisplayId`: Searches on `customer.displayId`
- `shipToPartyId`: Searches on `shipToParty.cuid`
- `anyCustomerAddressName`: Searches on any person names under `customer.addresses`
- `anyCustomerName`: Searches on any customer or customer address person names
- `anyShipToPartyName`: Searches on any ship-to party person names
- `anyCustomerOrShipToPartyName`: Searches on any customer, ship-to party, and address names
- `anyEmail`: Searches on email addresses across `customer.addresses` and `shipToParty.address`
- `anyPhone`: Searches on phone numbers across `customer.addresses` and `shipToParty.address`
- `customFields/{*}`: Searches on custom fields at the order header level with or without specifying an index for nested arrays
- `blocked`: Searches on whether the order is blocked or not. Note that this filter is only available if you have auditor permissions. Example: `blocked eq true`

The filter can also use the `startswith` or `stringequals` functions for case-insensitive string comparisons of the following fields:
- `orderId`
- `anyCustomerAddressName`
- `anyCustomerName`
- `anyShipToPartyName`
- `anyCustomerOrShipToPartyName`
- `anyEmail`
- `anyPhone`

The following comparison operators are supported:
- `eq`: equals
- `gt`: greater than
- `lt`: less than
- `ge`: greater than or equals
- `le`: less than or equals

The supported logic operators are `and` and `or`. Parentheses can also be used for subexpressions.

Examples:
  - order display ID: `/orders?$filter=orderDisplayId eq 12341234`
  - date range: `/orders?$filter=createdAt ge '{from}' and createdAt le '{to}'`. `{from}` and `{to}` are date-times expressed in the format "2020-08-14T19:57:33.048Z" (in UTC)
  - customer ID: `/orders?$filter=customerId eq '{customerId}'`
  - mixed: `/orders?$filter=createdAt ge '{from}' and customerId eq '{customerId}'`
  - starts with: `/orders?$filter=startswith(anyCustomerName, 'Rob')`
  - email starts with: `/orders?$filter=startswith(anyEmail, 'jane@')`
  - custom field: `/orders?$filter=customFields/property/color eq 'red' and customFields/property/ready eq true and customFields/customArray[]/size eq 'M'`

parameters.name: $orderby
parameters.description:
The field to use to sort the results. A single field is supported.
If omitted, the returned orders are sorted by default from the most recently created orders (`createdAt`).
The following fields are supported:
- `orderId`
- `orderDisplayId`
- `createdAt`
- `modifiedAt`
- `status`
- `marketId`
- `owner`
- `transferHoldEndAt`
- `precedingDocumentExternalNumber`

patch.summary: Changes the transfer hold for an order.
patch.description:
Extends or reduces the transfer hold time for an order. The order can't be sent for orchestration before the time present in the transferHoldEndAt field of the order. The transfer hold time can only be changed when an order is in status `TRANSFER_ON_HOLD`. In addition, the extension time can’t be changed 30 seconds before the transfer hold is set to end.
The hold duration can be extended for a maximum of 365 days after the order creation time, and can be reduced to send orders that meet certain criteria to the fulfillment system earlier. Note that the full request cannot exceed 2 MB.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The latest version of the order that you want to change the transfer hold for. This value can be retrieved from the "ETag" header of the /orders/{id} endpoint (GET operation).

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: The technical identifier of the order to be retrieved.

blocked.description: The flag to indicate whether an order is blocked for reasons of data protection and privacy. This field is only visible to users who are assigned the DPPAudit scope for auditing purposes. For information, see the Security section of the Service Guide.

businessObjectId.description: The unique identifier provided in the order payload to ensure that a duplicate order could not be created in SAP Order Management foundation.

version.description: The version of the order, used for optimistic locking.

precedingDocument.description: The document that triggered the order creation.

externalNumber.description: The preceding document number from the external system.

owner.description: The user responsible for the order. An owner is only assigned when an order is created on behalf of a customer, for example, if a sales agent or call center employee places an order for a customer.

createdAt.description: The creation date and time for the order.

createdBy.description: The user who created the order.

modifiedAt.description: The date and time the order was last updated.

modifiedBy.description: The user who last updated the order.

displayId.description: The outward-facing identifier of the order.

channel.description: The means by which the order is received in SAP Order Management foundation (for example, Web, IoT, call center). Note that this may represent an intermediary channel, and not necessarily the channel in which the order was originally placed.

id.description: The ID for the channel from which the order was received.

statusReasonCodes.description: The reason codes explaining why an order is in status PENDING.

items.description:
The reason code explaining why an order is in status PENDING.
CUSTOMER_CUID_UNKNOWN: The ID from the customer master data is not available in SAP Order Management foundation.
CUSTOMER_EXTERNAL_REF_UNKNOWN: The customer ID from the external system (for example, an online store) is not available in SAP Order Management foundation.
SHIP_TO_PARTY_CUID_UNKNOWN: The ID for the ship-to party from the customer master data is not available in SAP Order Management foundation.
SHIP_TO_PARTY_EXTERNAL_REF_UNKNOWN: The ship-to party ID from the external system (for example, an online store) is not available in SAP Order Management foundation.
SOURCING_UNKNOWN_OR_INCOMPLETE: Part or all of the sourcing information is missing. This status is only relevant if you are using a sourcing-based orchestration strategy.
SOURCING_REQUEST_ADDRESS_MISSING: The ship-to address is missing from the sourcing information. This status is relevant if SAP Order Management foundation is integrated with a sourcing solution. In this case, the integrated sourcing system cannot be reached because of the missing ship-to address.

statusMessages.description: The list of messages explaining why an order is in status CREATION_FAILED.

market.description: The market for the order. For more information about markets, see the Business Configuration information in the Service Guide.

currency.description: The currency of the order. Only the three-letter ISO currency code (ISO 4217) is accepted.

priceType.description: The price type used for the order: NET or GROSS.

timeZone.description: The time zone of the order.

payment.description: The information received in the order from your payment provider (for example, the SAP digital payments add-on).

method.description: The method of payment defined in SAP Order Management foundation.

type.description: The type of electronic payment for external payments.

cardToken.description: The payment card token provided by the payment service. The token is used to determine the remaining information related to payment card payments. Note that credit card information is not stored in SAP Order Management foundation.

id.description: The unique identifier for authorization provided by the payment service.

merchantId.description: The unique number issued by the acquirer or payment service provider to identify a merchant to settle external payments.

amount.description: The gross value that is to be billed for external payments. A maximum of 13 digits is allowed before the decimal point, and a maximum of two digits (decimal places) is allowed after. A maximum of 15 digits is allowed when the value does not contain a decimal point.

paymentServiceProvider.description: The payment service provider sent to the payment system for external payments. For example, you are processing an external payment and send the payment service provider 'PAYPAL' to the SAP digital payments add-on.

transactionId.description: The transaction ID for external payments.

customFields.description: The custom fields for a payment. This field will only be filled if the payment method is 'CUSTOM'.

pricingDate.description: The date and time used to determine the price for the subscription. Note that this field is only relevant for subscription items.

period.description: The duration for which the charge is applied. It applies to recurring and recurring estimate price categories.

itemsSubtotal.description: The subtotal of the order items.

originalAmount.description: The sum of all the original amounts of the items in the order. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

effectiveAmount.description: The sum of all the effective amounts of the items in the order. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

finalAmount.description: The sum of all the final amounts of the items in the order. The sum represents what the customer will be charged. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

discount.description: The schema for the discounts in an order.

totalAmount.description: The sum of all discounts applied. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

feesSubtotal.description: The subtotal of the fees for the order.

originalAmount.description: The sum of all original amounts of the fees in the order.

effectiveAmount.description: The sum of all the effective amounts of the fees in the order.

finalAmount.description: The sum of all the final amounts of the fees in the order. The sum represents what the customer will be charged.

originalAmount.description: The sum of all the original amounts in the order. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

effectiveAmount.description: The sum of all the effective amounts in the order. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

finalAmount.description: The amount represents what the customer will be charged for the order. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

discount.description: The schema for the discounts in an order.

totalAmount.description: The sum of all discounts applied. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

category.description: The category of the fee. Only one fee is accepted for each fee category. For example, you can only include one payment fee.

originalAmount.description: The initial or base amount of a fee. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

effectiveAmount.description: The original amount of a fee (minus discounts). An effective amount is mandatory when the price type of the market is defined as net. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

finalAmount.description: The amount of the fee the customer will be charged. A final amount is mandatory when the price type of the market is defined as gross. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

totalAmount.description: The sum of all taxes applied.

discount.description: Detailed information about discounts to be calculated, such as the amount and rate of the discount.

totalAmount.description: The sum of all discounts applied.

fulfillment.description: The fulfillment information from the fulfillment system for the order.

shipment.description: The shipment information for the order. Note that this information reflects the shipment information from the fulfillment system.

fullyShipped.description: The flag to indicate whether the full order has been shipped to the customer. Note that the status of this attribute is only updated to ''true'' when confirmation is received from the Order Activities API that all order items in the order have been shipped. Until that point, the Orders API has no information about the order shipment status and it cannot be inferred.

fullyDelivered.description: The flag to indicate whether the full order has been delivered to the customer. Note that the status of this attribute is only updated to ''true'' when confirmation is received from the Order Activities API that all order items in the order have been fully delivered. Until that point, the Orders API has no information about the order delivery status and it cannot be inferred.

amount.description: The numeric value indicating the price of an item.

blockSize.description: A value that determines the block size.

includedQuantity.description: A value that represents the included quantity of a usage-based price type.

billedInAdvance.description: A value that determines if a subscription is billed in advance.

priceTotals.description: The price totals for the item.

originalAmount.description: The initial or base price of a product, comprising the unit price multiplied by the quantity. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

effectiveAmount.description: The original amount minus discounts. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

finalAmount.description: The amount that the customer will be charged for the quantity ordered. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

category.description: The category of the prices which can be one-time, recurring, or recurring estimate.

totalAmount.description: The sum of all taxes applied. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

fulfillment.description: The fulfillment information from the fulfillment system for the order item.

shipment.description: The shipment information for the order item. Note that this information reflects the shipment information from the fulfillment system.

shippingDate.description: The most recent date and time at which a certain quantity of a product ordered is shipped to the customer. For example, if a customer orders three hinges and two hinges have been shipped, this date reflects the most recent shipping date. The date will be updated when the final hinge is shipped.

deliveryDate.description: The most recent date and time at which the customer receives a certain quantity of a product ordered. For example, if a customer orders three hinges and two hinges have been delivered, this date reflects the most recent delivery date. The date will be updated when the final hinge is delivered to the customer.

fullyShipped.description: The flag to indicate whether the full quantity of an item ordered has been shipped to the customer. Note that the status of this attribute is only updated to ''true'' when confirmation is received from the Order Activities API that the item has been fully shipped. Until that point, the Orders API has no information about the item shipment status and it cannot be inferred.

fullyDelivered.description: The flag to indicate whether the full quantity of an item ordered has been delivered to the customer. Note that the status of this attribute is only updated to ''true'' when confirmation is received from the Order Activities API that the item has been fully delivered. Until that point, the Orders API has no information about the item delivery status and it cannot be inferred.

cancellation.description: The cancellation information for the order item.

cancellationDate.description: The date and time at which the order item was canceled by the fulfillment system.

canceled.description: The flag to indicate whether the order item was canceled during the fulfillment process.

fulfillmentRequests.description: The list of fulfillment requests associated with the order item.

quantityValue.description: The quantity value for the fulfillment request.

validTo.description: The end of the validity period for subscription items.

contractTerm.description: The information for the contract term for a subscription item. This represents the minimum contract term of the subscription. During the minimum term, the subscription cannot be canceled.

endDate.description: The end date of the minimum contract term for a subscription item.

renewalTerm.description: The period by which the subscription automatically extends after the minimum contract term.

period.description: The length of the renewal term in months.

allowMidBillCycleExpiration.description: The flag to determine whether a subscription may expire in the middle of a billing cycle.

termOfNotice.description: The period of time to be observed if a customer wants to cancel a subscription.

overwriteContractTerm.description: The flag to determine whether the subscription terms predefined in the product can be overwritten.

calculateSubscriptionEndDate.description: The flag to enable the calculation of the subscription end date.

numberOfWaiverPeriods.description: The number of billing cycles for which recurring charges are waived after the start of the subscription.

periodicity.description: The duration for which the charge is applied, such as monthly.

customFields.description: Customized data that must be provided as a JSON object. The top-level structure of the customFields attribute must not be an array; however, JSON arrays can be included within the customFields structure at lower levels. The reservation information from the sourcing solution for the order items. This reserves the products at a specific fulfillment site to ensure that they will be available for shipping. The reservation can be included at header or shipment level.
Header level: The reservation information is available at the header level if full or partial sourcing information is present in the order create request. In this case, the reservation applies to the full or partial quantity of order items that include a fulfillment site in the shipment information.
Shipment level: The reservation information is available at shipment level if your sourcing system is integrated directly with SAP Order Management foundation and the full sourcing information is not received in the order create request. In this case, the missing reservation information is retrieved and stored at the shipment level.

extendTransferHoldRequest.description:
The request to extend or reduce the transfer hold for an order. This can only be applied to orders in status `TRANSFER_ON_HOLD`. In addition, the extension time can’t be changed 30 seconds before the transfer hold is set to end.
You can set a new transfer hold duration by increasing or decreasing the value of the extensionTime field. This can be done multiple times, with each update changing the value of the transferHoldEndAt field accordingly. The transfer hold can be extended up to a maximum total of 365 days after order creation, or reduced until the current time. The increase or reduction is entered in minutes and can be between -525600 and 525600 (365 days in minutes). Note that you can’t enter “0” as the value for the extensionTime field.
    When you increase the transfer hold duration by entering a positive value in the extensionTime field, the request will fail in the following cases:
  • The value entered is greater than 525600 (365 days).
  • The updated value of the transferHoldEndAt field after the extensionTime is increased is more than 365 days after the order creation date.
    When you decrease the transfer hold duration by entering a negative number in the extensionTime field, the API behaves as follows:
  • If the extension time is less than -525600 (example: -525601), the request will fail.
  • If the extension time entered sets the value of the transferHoldEndAt field in the past (before the current time), the current time is used and the order is sent immediately for processing.

Note that the full request cannot exceed 2 MB.

Note that if you make changes to the information in the following elements of the payload, you must send all the information within the element, even the unchanged values:

-	 fees
-	 orderItems
-	 shipments

id.description: The unique identifier of the sourcing reservation for all products in the order.

precedingDocumentInOrderCreateRequest.description: The document that triggered the order creation.

externalSystemId.description: The ID of the external system where the preceding document was created.

externalId.description: The preceding document ID from the external system.

externalNumber.description: The preceding document number from the external system.

channelInRequestOrResponse.description: The means by which the order is received in SAP Order Management foundation (for example, Web, IoT, call center). Note that this may represent an intermediary channel, and not necessarily the channel in which the order was originally placed.

id.description: The ID for the channel from which the order was received.

customerExternalSystemReference.description: The external system references for the customer. This represents an external system (such as an online store) that provides customer data as part of the order payload.

externalSystemId.description: The ID of the external system that provides the customer data.

externalId.description: The customer ID from the external system.

addressType.description: The type of the address, for example, the bill-to, ship-to, or sold-to address.

items.description: The address information for the order.

academicTitle.description: The person's academic title, for example, Dr.

shipToPartyInCreateOrderRequest.description: The information for the customer (partner) who will receive the order. If this schema is present, the ship-to address should be provided here and not in the customer schema.

cuid.description: The ID for the customer from the master data.

displayId.description: The outward-facing identifier of the customer. This field is required if you have disabled customer data enrichment in Business Configuration. It is not used otherwise.

type.description: The type of ship-to-party, for example, a person or company.

company.description: The company name of the individual customer.

allOf.description: The person's names and titles. This field is optional if you have disabled customer data enrichment in Business Configuration. It is not used otherwise. Include this information in the order payload if you need it for reference.

shipToPartyExternalReferences.description: The external system references for the customer. This represents an external system (such as an online store) that provides customer data as part of the order payload.

externalSystemId.description: The ID of the external system that provides the customer data.

externalId.description: The customer ID from the external system.

allOf.description:
The address information in which you specify a billing and shipping address for the customer. Other address types are not accepted.
Ensure that you have provided the correct format of data for the fields in the Address structure based on the requirements of your fulfillment system. For example, use ISO codes if necessary.

headerDiscountInRequestOrResponse.description: Detailed information about discounts to be calculated, such as the amount and rate of the discount.

totalAmount.description: The sum of all discounts applied. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

lines.description: Detailed information about discounts to be calculated, such as the amount and rate of the discount.

amount.description: The amount of the discount. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

sequenceNumber.description: The position of this discount in the sequence of discounts applied to the item.

basedOn.description: The preceding sequence number, on which the current discount is applied. If the discount is the first applied in the sequence, the value of this field should be null.

rate.description: The discount rate, expressed as a percentage.

orderItemPriceInRequest.description: The price for the product. This field is only relevant for physical items.

physicalItemPrice.description: The pricing information for the physical items in an order. All physical items in an order must have the same pricing and tax structure. For example, if all pricing-related fields for an item are present, then the fields for the remaining items must also be present. The same applies to the tax-related fields. (Note that the tax-related fields are optional.)

priceTotals.description: The price totals for the item.

category.description: The category of the price totals. The category must be 'ONE_TIME'.

originalAmount.description: The initial or base price of a product, comprising the unit price multiplied by the quantity. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

effectiveAmount.description: The original amount minus discounts. An effective amount is mandatory when the price type of the market is defined as net. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

finalAmount.description: The amount that the customer will be charged for the quantity ordered. A final amount is mandatory when the price type of the market is defined as gross. The maximum value is 9999999999999.999999.

orderItemPriceAspectsDataSubscriptionIte.description: The pricing information for subscription items in orders. This field is required if you have disabled product data enrichment in Business Configuration. It is not used otherwise.
Determines the pricing for a subscription item. This field is required if you have disabled product data enrichment in Business Configuration. It is not used otherwise.

id.description: The unique identifier of the pricing strategy. This field is required if you have disabled product data enrichment in Business Configuration. It is not used otherwise.

subscriptionItem.description: The information for a subscription item in an order.

allOf.description: The start of the validity period for subscription items.
The end of the validity period for subscription items.

renewalTerm.description: The period by which the subscription automatically extends after the minimum contract term.

period.description: The length of the renewal term in months.

allowMidBillCycleExpiration.description: The flag to determine whether a subscription may expire in the middle of a billing cycle.

termOfNotice.description: The period of time to be observed if a customer wants to cancel a subscription.

overwriteContractTerm.description: The flag to determine whether the subscription terms predefined in the product can be overwritten.

calculateSubscriptionEndDate.description: The flag to enable the calculation of the subscription end date.

numberOfWaiverPeriods.description: The number of billing cycles for which recurring charges are waived after the start of the subscription.

orderItemAspectsDataContractTermInReques.description: The information for the contract term for a subscription item. This represents the minimum contract term of the subscription. During the minimum term, the subscription cannot be canceled.

period.description: The period of the minimum contract term in months.

endDate.description: The end date of the minimum contract term for a subscription item.
